sources.title: MAGI-1: Autoregressive Video Generation at Scale - GitHub
sources.snippet: We present MAGI-1, a world model that generates videos by autoregressively predicting a sequence of video chunks, defined as fixed-length segments of consecutive frames. Trained to denoise per-chunk noise that increases monotonically over time, MAGI-1 enables causal temporal modeling and naturally supports streaming generation. It achieves strong performance on image-to-video (I2V) tasks ...

sources.title: GEHIRNS (GEHIRNS) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: magi-1.0 GEHIRNS/magi-1.0 is Qwen3.5-4B in 1.80 GiB, with no training. Each tensor class is stored at the precision its measured sensitivity calls for, using only standard GGUF types, so the file runs in stock llama.cpp and Ollama. With an 8-bit KV cache (magi-1.0 + q8 KV) it keeps 96% of the full model's benchmark score in 30% of the GPU memory and decodes 2.7× faster.
